deploy.startCommand: php artisan config:cache; php artisan route:cache; php artisan view:cache; php artisan storage:link --force; php artisan migrate --force --no-interaction; php artisan db:seed --force --no-interaction; php -d upload_max_filesize=20M -d post_max_size=20M -d memory_limit=256M artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
